name: Get Lists by Lead ID
summary: Shows every static list that a specific lead belongs to.
whenToUse: When you want to know which static lists contain a given lead — useful for dedupe checks and membership audits.

query.name: batchSize
query.label: Batch size (max per page)
query.hint: Optional. Maximum records per response (max 300). Leave blank for the default.

response.description: Array of lists: listId, createdAt, updatedAt.
